concerns.description: {label_name} concerns — underlying processes the population seems to be continuously trying to resolve.

description.description: Why this concern emerges from the data. What process is being resolved.

grounding_categories.description: Category labels that support this concern (from the unified categories list).

confidence.description: How well-supported this concern is by the current data.

analysis_units.description: Alternative units of analysis (roles, groups, institutional positions) suggested by emerging patterns in the data.

label.description: Descriptive label for this unit of analysis (e.g. 'Team leads', 'New hires', 'Cross-functional group').

description.description: What distinguishes this unit conceptually — what role, position, or grouping matters.

rationale.description: Why this unit of analysis matters for the emerging theory, grounded in the data.

recommendation.description: Either 'keep' or 'change_to:X' where X is the recommended style.

rationale.description: Why keep or change the coding style.

missed_patterns.description: Patterns the current coding style might miss. Empty if style is adequate.

rationale.description: Overall assessment narrative explaining the critic's evaluation.

referenced_entities.description: Entities from the database that were referenced in this analysis. Populated by the orchestration layer for traceability.

segment_ids.description: Segment IDs referenced in this output.

code_ids.description: Category/code IDs referenced in this output.

hypothesis_ids.description: Hypothesis IDs referenced in this output.

incident_ids.description: Incident IDs referenced in this output.

document_ids.description: Document IDs referenced in this output.
